brightport_barthold1.m: Is that so? I'm a little disappointed, thought you're more than just a sheep butcher.

brightport_barthold2.m: You can stick around though, but we don't have any more work for you.

brightport_goons.m: Who are you, and what do you need from us?
r: What do you do around here?

brightport_goons0.m: Who in Dhayavar are you? You better get out of here before we mess you up!

brightport_goons1.m: Yeah yeah, get out of here!

brightport_goons10.m: Hey Dynes! have you seen this Andor guy?

brightport_goons12.m: You heard him. Sorry we have no information to help you. Anything else?
r: Benbyr said to come and see you.

brightport_goons13.m: It's nice to see a trustworthy fellow like you around. You need something?
r: I'm looking for my brother Andor, have you seen him?
Benbyr said to come and see you.

brightport_goons15.m: Don't lump us in with him. Benbyr's greed got the best of him, he started dealing with rather questionable merchandise. On the other hand, we're not doing anything illegal, just inconvenient for those stuck-up guards.
r: Inconvenient enough that you can't do your work anymore, sounds like it's illegal to me.

brightport_goons16.m: We have some deliveries to make, but we're under observation and can't receive more merchandise. If we had a new face to do it for us, we could fare better.

brightport_goons17.m: Listen, all our goods are legal. But they want us to pay those things called "taxes" and follow their "trade restrictions" Completely ridiculous! So, you want to work for us or not?

brightport_goons18.m: Hmm, on second thoughts, I'd feel bad about giving you that kind of responsibility. Gunfryk's men are ruthless, if you get caught, you'll have no peace in Brightport.
r: I met Gunfryk, he didn't seem like a bad guy.

brightport_goons19.m: He is the guard captain. We used to make a killing with our trade. Well, we're still in business but Gunfryk has significantly cut down on it. His men pay no heed to bribes or the Shadow, except for some enlisted locals.

brightport_goons2.m: Wait, wait Barthold! Isn't that the kid?

brightport_goons20.m: Yeah, he really complicated things. That guard outside has been there watching us for a year now. We've only managed to stay afloat thanks to a cave I use to hide some merchandise.
r: Then all that it takes should be getting rid of him?

brightport_goons21.m: That's a dangerous thing you're saying, there is no way you can do that. He's not exactly a sheep; Gunfryk is a skilled and cunning warrior.

brightport_goons22.m: Yeah you'd have to be more discreet, we don't want things to go in a worse direction. If you can pull it off, we'll reward you handsomely. But if you fail you've got nothing to do with us. Understand?

brightport_goons23.m: Dang it, Dynes, don't egg on the kid. Killing is off the list, understood? Just make him less of a problem for us.
r: Got it, I'll "persuade" him to not be a problem, heh.
How else can I deal with him then?

brightport_goons24.m: I don't know, you're our sheep culling expert here. But surely Gunfryk has some secrets he wishes to hide.

brightport_goons25.m: Hey kid, any news on your task?
r: It was a hard fight, but I killed him, They'll probably think a lizardman got him.
I think you guys owe me some gold now.
I tried so hard, and got so far. But in the end, I couldn't find anything.
Good news. The commander's going to be turning a blind eye to your deals for a while. [Show him the compromising records.]
No. But I'll see it through.

brightport_goons26.m: You killed him!? You're really tough! But him being dead is not ideal.

brightport_goons27.m: What's wrong, Barthold? With Gunfryk dead, we've got free rein!

brightport_goons28.m: Free rein? It bought us time. Even if it looked like a lizardman attack, there's no guarantee the replacement Feygard sends won't be someone more extreme.

brightport_goons29.m: Anyway, here's your reward. With skills like yours, you'll surely find more work to do for our friends in Nor City.
r: At least I got some gold.

brightport_goons30.m: Give me that! [Barthold skips through some of the pages with a puzzled expression.]

brightport_goons31.m: Ha ha ha ha! That's soo funny, who would have guessed that stern Feygard dog would have such hobbies. And in Nor City nonetheless! Northerners and their pride. He surely wants to avoid his men finding out.

brightport_goons32.m: And for a job well done here is your reward; rather generous I say. You'll surely find more work to do in Nor City, just tell them Barthold sent you.
r: If not information about my brother at least some gold.

brightport_goons33.m: Ha! What gives, or are you making a joke?
r: You don't have the Guild's protection. Either I give this blade I took from your hideout to the guards. Or 2,000 gold. You pick.

brightport_goons34.m: Argh! Dynes, hand him all of our gold!

brightport_goons35.m: Dynes begrudgingly takes out a bag of gold and throws it your way.

brightport_goons36.m: Curses on that Benbyr for sending a rat like you our way! Now get out breadface, our deal is over!

brightport_goons37.m: The old commander's gone but his mutts have kept their pace, though we've managed to sneak in a few more bribes than usual, he he.

brightport_goons38.m: Feygard sent a new guy if you haven't heard already. Seems like your lie has worked. This guy is more of a warrior than a justiciar, so we're optimistic for now.
r: If you need someone dead you know who to call. The guard buster $playername.

brightport_goons4.m: It's the kid Benbyr wrote us about, remember?

brightport_goons5.m: Oh yeah, kinda does look like the one he wrote us about.

brightport_goons6.m: I was convinced you were sent to spy on us. So, what brings you around here.
r: I'm looking around the town searching for my brother.
Benbyr said to come see you.

brightport_goons7.m: Really, what does he look like?
r: He looks a lot like me, his name is Andor.

brightport_goons8.m: Benbyr did? Ha! I guess that guy's still up for business! Say, you want to work for us?
r: The kind of work that sent Benbyr to jail? No thanks.
I'm not sure, what kind of work exactly?
Sure, I have a history of getting things done.

brightport_goons_after.m: Enjoy your reward, traitor. Just remember, that gold won't keep you safe when my friends set their eyes on you!

brightport_goons_after0.m: How dare you come back after selling us out! Hope the gold was worth it, coward.

brightport_goons_after1.m: Good to see you again, friend. Business has been steadier lately.

brightport_goons_after2.m: Nice to see you around $playername. Can't say we've been doing better than before.

brightport_goons_after3.m: Oh shut up, we still have an investigation to do here.

brightport_goons_gaveup.m: Hello, friend. It's a shame you helped our friend but couldn't help us.
r: Well I'm a bit busy searching for my brother.

brightport_goons_gunfryk.m: On the surface, he's done good for the locals, they like him, like sheep love the shepherd. But for us, who keep the economy of this town alive, the laws he's upholding have done us more harm than good.

brightport_goonselectorbribe.m: How dare you come back after selling us out! I hope the gold was worth it, coward.

benbyr.10: I have met Benbyr outside the Crossroads guardhouse. He wants to get revenge on an old 'business partner' of his - Tinlyn. Benbyr wants me to kill all Tinlyn's sheep.
benbyr.20: I have agreed to help Benbyr find Tinlyn's sheep and kill all eight of them. I should go look for them in the fields northwest of the Crossroads guardhouse.
benbyr.21: I have started attacking the sheep. I should return to Benbyr once I have killed all eight of them.
benbyr.30: Benbyr was thrilled to hear that all of Tinlyn's sheep are dead.
benbyr.60: I declined to help Benbyr kill the sheep.

brightport_goons.10: Inside a house in Brightport, I met two people named Dynes and Barthold. It turned out that they are the friends Benbyr told me to visit. Rather lacking in hospitality, they offered me work.
brightport_goons.20: Barthold was hesitant because any job I could do for them would put me at odds with Gunfryk the guard commander. Taking that into account I offered to rid them of him.
brightport_goons.30: I was told not to kill him, but surely it won't be a problem if I do. Either way I'll resolve things for them.
brightport_goons.40: I received some records from silvear that could be useful as blackmail against Gunfryk.
brightport_goons.60: I used the records to blackmail Gunfryk. To save his reputation he begrudgingly agreed to give Barthold and Dynes some leeway.
brightport_goons.50: I lied to the commander that there are some lizardmen in the derelict house east of town, I should go there and prepare an ambush.
brightport_goons.70: I ambushed and killed Gunfryk in the house to the east, along with the two guards he brought.
brightport_goons.80: I informed the commander about Barthold and Dynes' scheme. He requested that I find some incriminating evidence of their role.
brightport_goons.110: I found some of the duo's merchandise in the smuggling cave east of brightport.
brightport_goons.130: I opted to blackmail the duo instead for some quick gold. Should've had the Guild's protection, suckers!
brightport_goons.135: I told the commander I couldn't find anything
brightport_goons.136: Barthold was disappointed in me for having done nothing about Gunfryk. Little did he know I lined my pockets with his merchandise.
brightport_goons.90: Barthold was happy with my work and gave me a reward, he said I could find more work like this in Nor City.
brightport_goons.100: Barthold was a little disappointed about me killing Gunfryk. It's possible that now Feygard might take more severe action with Brightport.
brightport_goons.120: Gunfryk was happy with my work, the duo will soon be jailed. He said Feygard needs more brave youngsters like me and that I should give the military academy a try.
brightport_goons.119: I gave the commander the blade, even though I already got paid not to. If there's any honor among Nor City's thieves, they will surely have none to spare for me.
brightport_goons.140: I told the commander I couldn't find anything, even though I had the blade I blackmailed Barthold and Dynes with.
